api:
<Gantt data={tasks} name={|t: &Task| t.name} start={|t: &Task| t.start} end={|t: &Task| t.end} group={|t: &Task| t.team} />
PropTypeDefault
dataVec<T>, Signal<Vec<T>>, or your own Datasetrequired
nameFn(&T) -> &str: the row labelrequired
start, endFn(&T) -> f64, milliseconds since the epochrequired
groupFn(&T) -> &str: the colour and legend entrythe task's name
row_heightf32: the share of a row the bar fills0.7
show_valueVisibilityMode: the label in each baras on <StateTimeline>
x_axisAxisConfiga time axis
legendLegendlists the groups
tooltip, classas on <StateTimeline>

One row per task, in your order.

Zoom: hold Ctrl (Cmd on macOS) and scroll, or pinch, to zoom the time axis about the pointer. Drag to select a range, and double-click to reset.

examples.title: Project plan
examples.description: One row per task, coloured by team.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn project() {
    let data = use_signal(plan());
    rsx! { <Gantt data={data} name={|t: &Task| t.name} start={|t: &Task| t.start} end={|t: &Task| t.end} group={|t: &Task| t.team} class="h-80" /> }
}

examples.title: Task names
examples.description: Bars labelled by task, thinner rows, no legend.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn by_task() {
    let data = use_signal(plan());
    rsx! { <Gantt data={data} name={|t: &Task| t.name} start={|t: &Task| t.start} end={|t: &Task| t.end} row_height={0.5} legend={Legend::hidden()} class="h-72" /> }

examples.title: Sprint
examples.code:
#[component]
fn sprint() {
    let data = use_signal(
        plan()
            .into_iter()
            .take(4)
            .map(|task| Task {
                end: task.start + (task.end - task.start) * 0.5,
                ..task
            })
            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
    );
    rsx! { <Gantt data={data} name={|t: &Task| t.name} start={|t: &Task| t.start} end={|t: &Task| t.end} group={|t: &Task| t.team} show_value={VisibilityMode::Never} class="h-56" /> }
}

examples.title: Conference
examples.description: Always-visible labels on tasks grouped by workstream.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn conference() {
    let data = use_signal(tasks(&[
        ("Venue", "Logistics", 0., 14.),
        ("Speakers", "Programme", 4., 30.),
        ("Sponsors", "Sales", 8., 40.),
        ("Tickets", "Sales", 20., 60.),
        ("Marketing", "Sales", 16., 58.),
        ("Schedule", "Programme", 28., 42.),
        ("Event day", "Logistics", 60., 62.),
    ]));
    rsx! { <Gantt data={data} name={|t: &Task| t.name} start={|t: &Task| t.start} end={|t: &Task| t.end} group={|t: &Task| t.team} show_value={VisibilityMode::Always} class="h-80" /> }
}
